subject: general
question: According to the Jal Jeevan Mission, what is the percentage target for rural households to receive tap water by 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**100%**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Jal Jeevan Mission aims to provide **100% functional household tap connections (FHTCs) to all rural households by 2024**.
 
• Launched by the Ministry of Jal Shakti in **August 2019**, the mission focuses on water supply infrastructure in rural areas.
 
• Under this initiative, **55 liters of water per person per day** is targeted to be supplied to every household.
 
• It emphasizes **community participation** and involves local bodies like Gram Panchayats in the implementation process.
 
• The scheme aligns with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goal-6, which ensures access to clean water and sanitation for all.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jal Jeevan Mission Key Components:**

 
 
• Ensures piped water supply to households in rural areas.
 
• Promotes decentralized service delivery models, including rainwater harvesting and greywater management.
 
• Focuses on water quality monitoring and testing to prevent contamination.
 
 
 
• **Community Participation:**
 
 
• Village Water and Sanitation Committees (VWSCs) play a crucial role in planning and executing projects.
 
• Capacity-building programs are conducted for local communities to ensure efficient water resource management.
 
 
 
• **Financial Allocation:**
 
 
• The scheme operates on a cost-sharing model between the central and state governments.
 
• Significant funds have been allocated to states based on their requirement and progress.
 
 
 
• **Challenges Addressed:**
 
 
• Addresses issues like water scarcity, contamination, and poor infrastructure.
 
• Encourages sustainable practices to ensure long-term water security.
